title: a method returns a BOOL, a SINT, a REAL and a DINT through its result slot, and an inherited method called as a statement leaves nothing
note: IEC 61131-3, methods: the value of a method is of its declared type (the SINT -5 keeps its sign, the DINT -70000 its width) and a call used as a statement discards it; twenty such calls of an inherited method in a loop load, and Bump ran twenty times
